To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“The integration of complex web applications can be achieved by employing modern structuring techniques and by using exception handling for tolerating errors”.
“Coordinated atomic actions can be used for structuring complex integrated systems and for handling exceptions, and protective wrappers can be used to encapsulate legacy components”.
the coordinated atomic actions, the protective wrappers, and the multilevel exception handlers are the main structuring techniques to be employed in integrating fault-tolerant web applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: 1.
structuring and fault tolerance in the context of web applications.
the design and implementation of a framework for building fault tolerant distributed web applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of modern structuring techniques is a promising approach to the development of fault tolerant web applications.
the use of the techniques described in this paper can help the developers of complex web applications to achieve the desired fault tolerance.
this paper shows how modern software engineering techniques can be employed to integrate complex web applications such that the resulting system can tolerate errors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a framework for integrating legacy web services into complex web applications.
it shows how to combine modern structuring techniques with the use of exception handling for the purpose of tolerating faults in integrated web applications.
we have provided a systematic way of structuring integrated web services in such a way as to allow their fault tolerance by means of exception handling.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structuring techniques for distributed applications, such as coordinated atomic actions, are also very useful in structuring web applications.
the techniques for building fault tolerant distributed systems developed for traditional distributed systems can also be applied to web applications.
the techniques we propose can be used to develop complex web applications that are tolerant to errors and are structured in a disciplined way.
